vetSays.line: 🛡️ Waman, Priya, Petra and Carlos met them at the door — 4 put down. Waman, Priya, Petra, Carlos are hurt.
🛡️ Dorothy, Connor, Waman, Petra and Raj met them at the door — 4 put down, 1 driven off. Dorothy, Waman, Petra, Raj are hurt.

📺 "Oh, you survived the AUDIENCE NOTES? Cute. We've stopped pretending these are animals now. That was the FINAL DRAFT, folks — what comes out of the treeline next was never alive the way you mean it."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Connor just put down Chorus Line... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Connor, Waman, Priya, Carlos and Raj met them at the door — 5 put down. Connor, Waman, Priya, Raj are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Dorothy just put down The Terms of Service... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Connor, Guohua, Waman, Dale and Raj met them at the door — 1 put down, 4 barely walked away. Connor, Guohua, Waman, Dale, Raj are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Guohua just put down The Redactor... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Priya just put down The Focus Group... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 "We've been watching you for a LONG time. Your faiths. Your formats. Your little institutions. So we built something out of... well. Out of YOU. Say hello to the MIRROR DRAFT."
🛡️ Connor, Guohua, Waman, Priya and Dale met them at the door — 2 put down, 2 barely walked away. Guohua didn't come back. Connor, Waman, Priya, Dale are hurt.

◈ ARC IV — THE INEFFICIENCY. SYSTEM: "ROUNDING ERROR RECLASSIFIED: ANOMALY. Organic consumption yields impossible output. Recalculating. Recalculating." — They finally see it. The thing they laughed at — needing to EAT — is the engine. Their confusion is your weapon now. You stood up to the calibration fauna, the audience's notes, the Final Draft — lived through their Show, weathered the worst together, and built something bigger than a village. One day humanity will need a case to make. The case is made of deeds, not words — and yours, though unfinished, are undeniable. (Feasted buffs burn ho
📺 "But finales — FINALES need a LEGEND, sweetheart. More STANDING — blood, bonds, or bread — and look the Mirror Draft in the eye. The producers are WAITING."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Priya just put down Spool... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Waman, Dale, Petra, Carlos and Raj met them at the door — 4 put down, 1 driven off. Waman, Dale, Petra, Carlos, Raj are hurt.

◈ SYSTEM: "Four waves. FOUR. The producers are — okay, I'm saying it: FINALES need a NATION. You've got a region; now make it a REALM. Bind fires under one head, or bend the knee to someone who has. The higher-ups are watching. ...Did I say higher-ups? I said NOTHING. Forget the higher-ups."
⚠ This one is different — scarred, braced, waiting for your opening. A Scarred veteran.
Dale strikes the Scarred Gavel.
It saw the opening coming — braced, scar tissue white. Your first strike glances off. (SCARRED: -3 first strike)
The Scarred Gavel falls.
📺 +20 style — dropped the Scarred Gavel!
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Connor just put down The Influencer... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Ruth just put down Ad Break... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Ruth met them at the door — 1 put down. Ruth is hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Connor just put down The Eater... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
◈ THE WAR PATH — The body count, itemized. The System is not making this up — it was filming. On day 89, you put down The Eater. On day 72, you put down The Ugly Beast.

"THE HERALD came. Named and located — the war council knew its face. They faced Loud-Eyes twice and lived to sit here. Even now the wave-5 bar reads: blood your fighters (1 of 2 veterans)." — the System is still reading the list.
